reviews.body: Classic black bomber will never go out of style. Perfect for LA weather most of the year. Has a light liner so it's more than just 1 ply. I bought the black color and its great. reviews.body: I get so many compliments on this coat, it was perfect for my trip to Europe, so versatile. I'm impressed with how well this coat is made!

Love this jacket. The fleece inner jacket zips discreetly inside the outer jacket. The middle zipper of the inner fleece jacket zips into each side of the outer jacket. It takes a little time to attach or detach the two. You have to zip or unzip each side, then fasten each sleeve at the cuff, and fasten the neckline. Great for travel to have 3 options, with unexpected weather. It fits great. I'm 5'6", 120 lbs. I ordered the large first, but ended up getting a medium instead, which is perfect. I still have room to wear a sweatshirt underneath. With the fleece jacket lining, the jacket does not slip on easily, but that's minor.

products.search_term: Tory Sport Tory Sport Sweatshirt
Tory Sport Tory Sport Track Jacket

reviews.body: Great feel, good fit (but order a size up), and cool retro look.

Very well made men’s track jacket! The sleeves were a little too short for my husband though, so we had to return it. I’m giving it 5 stars because my 6’3” husband has very long arms & struggles finding clothes that fit. Otherwise this jacket is really nice. The material seems very high quality.

The complimentary and analogous color choices of these jackets from dioxoib make it clear that someone with definite skill was in charge of that aspect of design. They have chosen compelling colors which are shades of primary colors, but far more interesting. Rather than the same tired hues we might expect, we are treated to surprising and unexpected shades.

The fabric is smooth and slick, the kind which might repel rain rather than absorb it. There isn't much lining, so I wouldn't have any illusions that the jacket will provide much warmth in cold weather, but still might be enough to mitigate a slight chill.

In terms of size, I ordered a 2x which runs smaller than most garments of that size. My son wears a large to extra large and this 2X fits him perfectly. He commented that the item has a slimming effect and for him that is true. It does. On me, because it is too tight, it accentuates my pudge.

Oddly, the zipper slider and teeth are on the opposite side one might expect. Come to think of it, maybe that accounts for why this jacket is not true to size. Even though the listing refers to the garment as a men's garment, maybe is was designed for a woman, since women's zippers are opposite of men's. For these reasons, I'm giving this item four stars, not the five I would otherwise give it.
